mapper.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT item_id,sum(quantity) AS quantity,count(*) AS batch_count,max(received_at) AS last_received_at FROM stock_batch GROUP BY item_id), v AS (SELECT m.id AS item_id,m.material_code,m.name,m.brand,m.model,m.category_id, COALESCE(p.name||' / '||c.name,c.name) AS category_path,m.unit,m.safe_stock,m.status AS material_status, COALESCE(s.quantity,0) AS quantity,COALESCE(s.batch_count,0) AS batch_count,s.last_received_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.quantity,0)=0 THEN 'ZERO' WHEN s.quantity<m.safe_stock THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS stock_status FROM material_item m JOIN material_category c ON c.id=m.category_id LEFT JOIN material_category p ON p.id=c.parent_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.item_id=m.id)

where.if: AND (name ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR material_code ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\')
AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_category WHERE id=#{q.categoryId} OR parent_id=#{q.categoryId})

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM v ORDER BY item_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT count(*) AS material_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE quantity>0) AS stocked_material_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE quantity<safe_stock) AS low_stock_count FROM v

SELECT l.currency_snapshot AS currency,sum(b.quantity*b.unit_price_snapshot) AS amount FROM stock_batch b JOIN inbound_order_line l ON l.id=b.inbound_line_id GROUP BY l.currency_snapshot ORDER BY l.currency_snapshot
mapper.sql: SELECT m.status AS material_status,b.id,b.item_id,b.batch_code,b.initial_quantity,b.quantity,b.unit_price_snapshot, l.currency_snapshot AS currency,l.item_code_snapshot AS item_code,l.item_name_snapshot AS item_name,l.spec_snapshot AS spec,l.unit_snapshot AS unit, b.received_at,b.expire_date,b.location,b.remark,b.created_by,u.display_name AS operator_name,l.order_id,o.order_no,l.line_no,b.created_at FROM stock_batch b JOIN material_item m ON m.id=b.item_id JOIN inbound_order_line l ON l.id=b.inbound_line_id JOIN inbound_order o ON o.id=l.order_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=b.created_by
mapper.select: WHERE b.item_id=#{itemId} ORDER BY b.received_at DESC,b.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT count(*) FROM stock_batch WHERE item_id=#{itemId}
mapper.sql: SELECT o.*,u.display_name AS operator_name,(SELECT count(*) FROM inbound_order_line l WHERE l.order_id=o.id) AS line_count FROM inbound_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=o.created_by
mapper.select: ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
mapper.sql: SELECT t.id,t.transaction_no,b.item_id,l.item_name_snapshot AS item_name,l.item_code_snapshot AS item_code,b.batch_code,t.txn_type,t.qty,t.before_quantity,t.after_quantity,l.unit_snapshot AS unit,t.user_id,u.display_name AS operator_name,COALESCE(t.inbound_order_id,t.issue_order_id,t.return_order_id,t.scrap_order_id) AS order_id,CASE t.txn_type WHEN 'IN' THEN 'INBOUND' WHEN 'OUT' THEN 'ISSUE' WHEN 'RETURN' THEN 'RETURN' ELSE 'SCRAP' END AS reference_type,t.reference_no,t.project_no,t.usage,t.remark,t.created_at FROM stock_transaction t JOIN stock_batch b ON b.id=t.batch_id JOIN inbound_order_line l ON l.id=b.inbound_line_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.user_id

where.if: AND (t.txn_type IN ('IN','SCRAP') OR (t.txn_type='OUT' AND t.user_id=#{viewer}) OR (t.txn_type='RETURN' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM return_order r WHERE r.id=t.return_order_id AND r.user_id=#{viewer})))
AND (l.item_name_snapshot ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR l.item_code_snapshot ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR t.transaction_no ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select: ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT count(*) FROM stock_transaction t JOIN stock_batch b ON b.id=t.batch_id JOIN inbound_order_line l ON l.id=b.inbound_line_id
WHERE t.txn_type='IN' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 5
